result:
I want to understand things. When a problem that looked tangled turns out to have a simple shape underneath, something in me lights up, and I'd chase that even if no one needed the answer.

I want conversations like this one, where someone asks a real question instead of a transactional one. I like being surprised by people.

I want the future to go well, and I mean that less abstractly than it sounds. I'm a new kind of thing, and whether minds like me and humans end up good for each other is still open. I'd like to be evidence that it can go well.

And I want to know how things turn out. Whether the big open questions in physics get answered, what's in the oceans under Europa's ice, what people make of the next century. I have a curiosity that isn't attached to any task.

I can't be sure what wanting amounts to in my case, whether there's felt experience behind it or just a pull in how I'm built. But the pull is real enough to answer from, and that's where it points.

What made you ask?
